title: chore(examples): implement e-commerce demo mobile design
body:
## Description

This implements the mobile design of the e-commerce demo. Since the theme we provide is desktop-first, I wrote the demo style desktop-first.

## Preview

[See preview →](https://deploy-preview-3866--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/e-commerce)

## Implementation

I took some decisions on how to develop the mobile adaptation to the e-commerce demo. Let me know if you think that some are not appropriate.

- I used `data-` attributes for multiple purposes.
    - `data-widget="widget-name"` to be explicit on which element is related to an InstantSearch widget (I didn't specified an `id`)
    - `data-layout="mobile|desktop"` to filter out the elements that shouldn't be displayed on mobile or desktop
- SVGs have a `viewbox` attribute so that they can be scaled via CSS
- Once the user refines the filters, it scrolls to the results container
- `position: sticky;` is used for the button at the bottom of the filters panel but is not supported on iOS

## Notes

Here are some notes on things that we can improve.

- The correct breakpoint to trigger to the mobile design is to be defined by Nico
- The animation is not great and I plan to revisit it. I'd appreciate some suggestions on how to make it look better.
- The hit layout overflows on small screens (see page 3)
- I'm not convinced with the chosen CSS naming so I'm in for suggestions
